title: I BUILT AN AI THAT STARTS YOUR COMPANY WHILE YOU WATCH
description:
I watched an autonomous AI employee build my entire brand while I sat there.

It named the company and wrote the brand guidelines. Then it designed the carousels and filmed the talking head video. The live website shipped right after. All the finished work landed in my messages like a teammate delivering files. You get one bill for the whole stack. Start for free or go monthly from $20.

Comment GEN and Gen will show you what it would do for your business.
